title: Ahlhorn or the south
what_we_know: The crew record puts mission seventeen at Ahlhorn. The family's clipping kept against that page names Ingolstadt, Fürth and Grafenwöhr.
what_we_dont: Where the crew went on 22 March 1945, or why the clipping was kept against that page.
what_might_answer_it: The 95th's mission report for 22 March 1945; the clipping itself, digitized.
evidence_needed: A 1945 record of the 95th's target that day.
